name: University of Tsukuba
summary: National university in Tsukuba science city, founded 1973: six English-taught bachelor's courses, from social studies to engineering.

ib.text: IB Diploma holders and expected holders (predicted grades) may apply; no minimum points. English proof: TOEFL iBT 61 or IELTS 5.0 (Engineering higher), waived after three years of English-medium school.

apply.via: Tsukuba online application system for English programmes

dates.label: Applications open for International Social Studies and Life and Environmental Sciences
Applications close, 17:00 JST: Social Studies and Life and Environmental Sciences
Second-stage online interviews begin (26 Feb to 8 Mar; Global Issues 1 to 4 Mar)

programmes.name: International Social Studies
programmes.about: A degree earned wholly through English-taught classes, analysing political, economic and cultural issues in international society. You apply to the College of Social Sciences or International Studies; the other is your automatic second choice.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents (transcripts, English score, reference letter, study plan), then an individual interview. 8 places: 4 for each college. Enrolment 1 September 2027.

programmes.name: Biological Sciences
programmes.about: A College of Biological Sciences degree in the English-only Interdisciplinary Program of Life and Environmental Sciences, giving a firm base and specialised knowledge in the life sciences.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, then an individual interview that tests English and basic science. 5 places. Enrolment 1 September 2027.

programmes.name: Agro-Biological Resource Sciences
programmes.about: A College of Agro-Biological Resource Sciences degree in the English-only Interdisciplinary Program of Life and Environmental Sciences, on the sustainable use of agro-biological resources and the environment.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, then an individual interview that tests English and basic science. 6 places. Enrolment 1 September 2027.

programmes.name: Geoscience
programmes.about: A College of Geoscience degree in the English-only Interdisciplinary Program of Life and Environmental Sciences, covering earth and environmental sciences.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, then an individual interview that tests English and basic science. The guidelines say "several students" are admitted. Enrolment 1 September 2027.

programmes.name: Interdisciplinary Engineering
programmes.about: Science and engineering taught in English from interdisciplinary angles, aimed at the next-generation smart society. Admission looks for basic maths, English and aptitude for engineering.
programmes.ib: Needs TOEFL iBT 80 (4.0 on the new scale) or IELTS 6.5, higher than other Tsukuba programmes; English-medium schooling waives it.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents and a reference letter, then an interview on English and basic subject knowledge. Dates are from Tsukuba's listing; the programme page still carries 2026 wording.

programmes.name: Global Issues
programmes.about: An international programme taught in English on global issues: earth environment, social diversity and inclusiveness, risk and security, and human health and wellbeing, drawing on the humanities and sciences.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, study plan and reference, then an online interview 1 to 4 March 2027. "Several students" are admitted. Enrolment 1 October 2027; needs TOEFL iBT 79 or IELTS 6.0.

notes: You may apply to only one Tsukuba English-taught programme, and cannot change programme or college after applying.
The ¥608,800 tuition is the rate for international students on a Student visa; Japanese residents pay ¥535,800. A one-off ¥282,000 admission fee applies.
Tsukuba offers a full or partial tuition waiver only to a limited number of students; Global Issues also nominates its top three MEXT-eligible applicants for a MEXT scholarship.
